substeps.caption: A sub-size printed bar, 3 x 1 mm in section, in its grips. The arm rides up the single column and pulls it: AlSi10Mg breaks it at 1.2-1.4 kN, within the frame's 2 kN.
Back to the start. A tabletop frame, but 1410 mm tall: even the shortest single column (1020 mm) is taller than a tray takes, so it stands beside the VLM.
